name: Sanghvi Brands Limited
about: Sanghvi Brands Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in establishing, acquiring, operating, importing, marketing, and promoting various branded goods and services in India, the Middle East, Maldives, Mauritius, Seychelles, and Sri Lanka. It provides spa, salon, gym, and wellness services under the Spa L'OCCITANE, Elle Spa & Salon, Warren Tricomi Salon & Spa, as well as JW Marriott, Accor, Hilton, IHG brand names. The company was incorporated in 2010 and is based in Pune, India.
